item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera sets up three similar money plant saplings at her home in Jaipur for a school science project. Pot 1 is kept in sunlight and watered every day. Pot 2 is kept in sunlight but is never watered. Pot 3 is watered every day but kept in a dark cupboard. After three weeks, which result should Meera expect, and what does it show?

options.A: Pot 2 grows best, because sunlight alone is enough for a plant to grow well
options.B: Pot 3 grows best, because regular watering alone makes plants grow well
options.C: Pot 1 grows best, because a plant grows best when it gets both sunlight and adequate water together
options.D: All three pots grow equally well, because sunlight and water each work in the same way
